items.rationale: Covered as repair of a fitting fractured by frost under 2.4.4 and 7.1.9; indemnity is for like-for-like replacement, including labour and necessary materials.
Covered as a connection element renewed with the fractured fitting per 7.1.9; necessary for reinstatement after frost damage.
Labour for repair of affected pipework/fitting is covered under 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9; reference cases show 3 hrs at ~90–110 EUR/hr gross.
Consumables actually used in covered repair are indemnified under 7.1.7(e); reference cases support a flat rate in the 30–45 EUR range.
Attendance for covered repair is indemnified (7.1.11); reference cases for similar plumbing jobs show 70–85 EUR per visit.
Leak location, including use of technical equipment, is covered up to 2,500 EUR per event (2.4.6, 5.2.2); reference cases for similar equipment use are 40–60 EUR.

items.description: Facade damage where the wall froze from the internal water escape
items.rationale: Repair of external render/plaster is covered because the damage was caused by water escaping from inside (2.4.3), not by external frost (3.5 does not apply); indemnity includes making good the affected area.
Removal of failed plaster is part of the necessary repair to the affected area (7.1.7(a), 7.1.5); covered as part of the reinstatement.
Renewal of the base plaster is necessary to restore the affected area (7.1.7(c), 7.1.5); covered as part of the repair.

If this refers to ancillary work directly required for reinstating the affected area, it is covered (7.1.7, 7.1.11); if it is a vague or administrative charge, it is not (3.6(b)), but in absence of detail, assume minor necessary work.
Making good the substrate is part of the repair to the affected area (7.1.7(c)); covered as necessary reinstatement.
Painting the repaired area is covered (7.1.7(d)), but only to the extent of the original finish; four coats is reasonable for exterior render.
Drying is necessary before repair of the affected area (7.1.7(c)); covered as part of the reinstatement.
Priming is a necessary preparatory step before painting/plastering (7.1.7(d)); covered as part of the repair.
Labour for reinstating the affected area is covered (7.1.7(f)); reference cases suggest 5 hrs at 40–60 EUR/hr gross.
If this is a lump-sum for covered work on the affected area, it is indemnified (7.1.12); if it is an admin/processing fee, it is not (3.6(b)), but in absence of detail, assume minor covered work.
